overview.name: Valued Advisers Trust - m+ DynaBuffer ETF
overview.description: Under normal market conditions, seeks to invest at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes in unfunded total return swaps (based on their notional value) that provide exposure to the HSBC DynaBuffer U.S. Large Cap Index (the “Buffer Index”). It is non-diversified.
